request.text: Shuru mein jab aap ne circle ke parts pooche to ek student ne '4' ka confident jawab diya. Phir kareeb 12 minute par jab aap ne proper fraction ka test diya aur 'kyun?' poocha, usi student ne '3,7...3,7...' repeat kiya. In do alag lamhon ke darmiyan unki soch mein kya badla, aur aap ka khayal hai agle bar aap waisa test phir den to ek chhota sa kya try karenge?
